user_alert_draft: New idea on the board: a replacement clamp for the Rad UI Remote/Display. It came out of last week's Facebook listen and is now KEEP_HUNTING with a finished competitor check. Rad doesn't sell the clamp by itself, so when it cracks owners have to buy the whole unit (about $80). No one sells a finished clamp for the left remote either. The closest product is a $28.99 bracket for the center display (nulkomma.com). Best quote, from a RadRover 6 owner: "The bracket that holds the UI remote broke on both of our Radrover 6 bikes. I am hoping someone has a 3D print file of this bracket… I am using cable ties but they are ugly and the remote keeps slipping." https://www.radowners.com/index.php?topic=9813.0 It passes the design gate, but most of the proof is over a year old, so I'm holding it at KEEP_HUNTING. Your RR3+ has this remote, so it could be measured alongside SUN-01. Also, the Aventon front basket moved up (unmet 18 to 48) on two Aventure owner asks, but it stays WATCH because a basket is load-bearing. SUN-01 (KEEP_HUNTING) and the organizer (DESIGN) are unchanged.
